phase_a_binding.seed_manifest_shared_identity_rule: shared_identity_sha256 must equal verified Phase-A shared_identity.identity_sha256 for the current seed
phase_a_binding.all_phase_a_map_rule: all_phase_a_shared_identity_sha256 must exactly equal the five-seed verified Phase-A identity map

arm_binding.descriptor_path_rule: each arm descriptor path must equal <arm>/arm_manifest.json
arm_binding.raw_manifest_identity_rule: descriptor manifest_sha256 must equal the raw arm manifest identity verified by that arm comparator
arm_binding.projected_identity_rule: accepted and fresh projected arm SHA-256 values must both be valid and equal; that common projected identity is recorded in the seed comparison result

raw_integrity_verification_order: verify seed-manifest payload_sha256 and manifest_sha256 before projection
require exact three-arm key set on accepted and fresh seed manifests
bind current-seed and all-five Phase-A shared identities to the verified Phase-A comparator result
verify every arm descriptor path, file SHA-256, and raw manifest_sha256 against the corresponding expected arm manifest
require every corresponding arm comparator result to pass before seed projection can pass

projection.rationale: the removed arm identities are transitively timing-dependent solely through the already frozen Phase-B maintenance/arm timing projection
exact_fields_include: all arm descriptor paths and any non-derived descriptor content
projection.equality_rule: accepted and fresh projected seed manifests must have identical canonical JSON SHA-256 and exact recursive content equality
